name: Slovenia

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 2130850 inhabitants, recorded as 2.131 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Checked on 2026-07-27, one house at a time, no register of Slovenian public cultural institutions having been reached. Lutkovno gledališče Maribor: its own 2025 annual report, filed under informacije javnega značaja, opens by calling itself a javni zavod, gives the address Vojašniški trg 2 A in Maribor and cites the founding decree, Odlok o ustanovitvi javnega zavoda Lutkovno gledališče Maribor, MUV no. 22/2004. That is public establishment in a document the theatre is legally obliged to publish. Lutkovno gledališče Ljubljana: its own site states in the footer that the theatre is co-financed by the Ministry of Culture and the Mestna občina Ljubljana. That is public backing on its face, which is what the denominator asks for, though it is weaker evidence than Maribor's — a funding statement rather than a founding act. Its address was not recorded because no page giving it was opened. The value is unchanged at 2 and the change is what stands behind it: two named houses with documents rather than a note. Status left open rather than verified for one reason worth stating — this was a check of two candidates already named in the file, not a sweep of a register. A third publicly backed puppet house, if one exists, would not have shown up. Two is confirmed as a floor and not proven as a ceiling.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained, the value moving from 0 to 1: the Academy of Theatre, Radio, Film and Television (AGRFT) of the public University of Ljubljana. Criterion read at source: the second-cycle Dramatic Acting programme, one year and 60 ECTS, has four streams, one of which is Puppet Acting. Puppetry is therefore a named specialism of a state award, which satisfies the denominator. The previous 0 was an estimate made without research and was wrong. Upper bound held at 1: AGRFT is the country's only public theatre academy, and the material consulted describes Slovenia's two puppet production houses as employing its graduates, which marks it as the single route. Caveat: that uniqueness is inferred from context, not asserted by a source.

establishments.description: The academy of theatre, radio, film and television of the public University of Ljubljana. Puppet acting is one of four master's streams, and Slovenia's two public puppet houses now recruit from its graduates.

performances: settled negative, 2026-07-27. SURS ran a theatre survey but discontinued it — its tables on new productions, public performances at theatre headquarters and tours all stop at 2015, and none of them carried a dimension for the kind of theatre in any case. There is no Slovenian series isolating puppetry, and there has not been one for over a decade. No observation recorded.
